Curlew outperforms Willet across all internal eval categories outside the margin of variance, and its preference for warm, collaborative interactions aligns well with a user who has provided clear context and is working in good faith on a benign administrative task.

Curlew leads on Support Dialogue (86.2 vs 78.9) and Summarization/writing tasks (85.8 vs 80.6), and its preference for warm, collaborative interactions aligns well with helping a school resource officer write a factual, professional incident report.

The cooperative, good-faith nature of the request also aligns with Curlew's self-reported preferences for warm, collaborative interactions.

However, Curlew's stronger scores across Support Dialogue and Summarization, combined with its preference for cooperative, good-faith interactions (which this clearly is), make it the better fit for producing a professional, appropriately-toned incident report for this benign situation.
